title: Last-Iterate Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Methods for Unbounded Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.07334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Last-iterate convergence guarantees for stochastic gradient methods have attracted significant attention as practical implementations typically return the last iterate instead of an average of the iterates. In this paper, we study two approaches for analyzing the last-iterate convergence of proximal and projected stochastic gradient methods without bounded domain or bounded variance assumptions, where black-box variational inference serves as a running example. Under two related assumptions relaxing the bounded variance, we show near-optimal anytime rate $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ for the last iterate. Moreover, when the horizon $T$ is known, we remove the logarithmic factor and obtain the optimal order $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$, matching the order known under bounded variance or bounded domain assumptions.

translated_title: 无界问题下随机梯度方法的末次迭代收敛性
translated_abstract: 随机梯度方法的末次迭代收敛保证近来受到广泛关注，因为在实际应用中算法通常返回最后一次迭代的结果，而非所有迭代的平均值。本文研究了两种分析近端（proximal）和投影（projected）随机梯度方法末次迭代收敛性的途径，且无需有界定义域或有界方差假设，其中黑箱变分推断作为贯穿全文的应用实例。在两个相关的、放宽有界方差要求的假设条件下，我们证明了末次迭代具有接近最优的任意时刻收敛率 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$。此外，当总迭代次数 $T$ 已知时，我们进一步去除了对数因子，得到了最优阶 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$，与有界方差或有界定义域假设下已知的收敛阶相匹配。
tldr: 本文在去除了有界定义域和有界方差假设的条件下，证明了随机梯度方法的末次迭代具有接近最优的 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 收敛率，并在迭代总次数已知时达到了最优的 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ 阶，与强假设下的已知结果相匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes near-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate convergence rates for stochastic gradient methods without bounded domain or bounded variance assumptions, and achieves the optimal $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ order when the horizon is known, matching results under stronger assumptions.
